# Mary Cassatt

> > Comprehensive digital gallery of American Impressionist Mary Cassatt's paintings, featuring her celebrated mother-child portraits and complete works catalog.

This site showcases the artistic legacy of Mary Cassatt (Mary Stevenson Cassatt), an American painter known for her impressionist works depicting intimate domestic scenes, children, and maternal bonds. The collection includes oil paintings, portraits, and detailed reproductions of her most significant artworks from her career in Pennsylvania and association with Edgar Degas.

## Key Topics

## Mother & Child Paintings

- [Maternal Kiss](https://www.marycassatt.org/Maternal-Kiss.html): Maternal Kiss oil painting depicting mother-child intimacy theme
- [The Bath I](https://www.marycassatt.org/The-Bath-I.html): The Bath I impressionist mother-child bathing scene painting
- [Mother and Child with a Rose Scarf (1908)](https://www.marycassatt.org/Mother-And-Child-With-A-Rose-Scarf-1908.html): Mother and Child with Rose Scarf 1908 impressionist portrait
- [Mother Holding Nude Baby](https://marycassatt.org/Mother-Holding-Nude-Baby.html): Mother Holding Nude Baby maternal impressionist artwork
- [Mother Looking Down at Her Blond Baby Boy](https://marycassatt.org/Mother-Looking-Down-At-Her-Blond-Baby-Boy.html): Mother looking down at blond baby boy, tender maternal portrait

## Children's Portraits

- [Baby Bill in Cap and Shift](https://www.marycassatt.org/Baby-Bill-In-Cap-And-Shift.html): Baby Bill In Cap And Shift oil painting with reproduction options
- [Little Girl in a Red Beret](https://www.marycassatt.org/Little-Girl-In-A-Red-Beret.html): Little Girl In A Red Beret impressionist children's portrait
- [Bust of Ellen with Bows in Her Hair](https://www.marycassatt.org/Bust-Of-Ellen-Wiith-Bows-In-Her-Hair.html): Bust portrait of Ellen with bows, impressionist children's portrait
- [Margot Wearing a Bonnet (2)](https://marycassatt.org/Margot-Wearing-A-Bonnet-2.html): Margot Wearing A Bonnet portrait from Margot series collection

## Individual Portraits & Other Works

- [Head of Adele](https://www.marycassatt.org/Head-Of-Adele.html): Head of Adele portrait painting with reproduction availability

- [The Mirror](https://www.marycassatt.org/The-Mirror.html): The Mirror oil painting with reproduction options available
- [The Flirtation: A Balcony in Seville](https://www.marycassatt.org/The-Flirtation-A-Balcony-In-Seville.html): The Flirtation: A Balcony In Seville 1873 Spanish scene painting
